cited.quote: This Government will arrange continued archaeological research at the sites of Keezhadi
Tamil heritage and cultural sites along the East Coast Road will be upgraded

rationale: C4 is a statement of intent for continued research at Keezhadi and other sites. C5 gives an allocation only for a project report on East Coast Road heritage sites, a different subject. C1 and C2 describe the department generally. None shows a dedicated Keezhadi fund allocation or an official step for this commitment.
